provenance.defaults: Every scalar below is assumed, including explicit zeros; zero is not evidence of no cost
provenance.rounding: Exact rational expected costs; output 10 decimals, half away from zero. Actual transactions need separately approved cent rounding.
provenance.omissions: Authorization/refund/payout fee allocated through cardExtraFee (currently assumed 0); cashCollectionCost assumed 0. Unknown real fees, insurance, taxes, PSP collateral/corporate credit, capex and staffing ramp require revision before decisions.
provenance.driverCosts: All working distance included once in fuel and maintenance; costs held constant under utilization/demand stress for conservative sensitivity; no guarantee of net income.
provenance.acquisition: Driver and passenger ride allocations are disjoint for this synthetic cohort; monthly spend 1000+4000 GEL per city = 25000 total. Not measured CAC. 3-month horizon; no invented 90-day retention observation.
provenance.month: One synthetic month plus uniform 12/15-month schedules, not activation. Each horizon starts with assumed 4950000 GEL, not committed capital; the separately calculated 6000000 GEL envelope is not injected as cash. Total 600000 research/acquisition reserve is spread over the horizon, split equally; CAC stress increases only acquisition. Fixed vendor baseline excludes incremental ride infrastructure. 250000 break-even oracle differs from 280000 bottom-up full fixed baseline. Shared fixed costs counted once across five cities.
provenance.cash: Collection/default fractions apply to new gross commission/service receivables; overdue remainder persists; no netting rights inferred. Card settlement fraction concerns retained platform fees after driver passthrough. Provider outage assumes no receipts for current card fees and 50% activity; already completed obligations remain.
